mina: Heads-up: autoscaler preemption simulation for eu-north on Wed 07/06 01:30-02:15 UTC. We'll simulate a 40% GPU pool preemption to validate cold-start behavior + autoscaler ramp. Internal SLO leniency and internal pager suppression will be enabled for the window. Please ack if you're impacted. :construction:

peter: Ack. Which autoscaler policy variant are we testing? burst-aware or legacy?

mina: We'll run burst-aware first, then fallback to legacy in the exercise if we hit instability. Sequence: preflight -> inject preemption -> 3% canary -> scale-up ramp -> full traffic -> cooldown. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/eng-sre/gpu-preempt-sim

ash: I'll own cold-start metrics and model-shard warmup checks. Preflight snippets:```
redwood-admin nodes list --region eu-north --pool gpu-pool
redwood-metrics query "gpu_startup_time_ms{region=\"eu-north\"}"
redwood-metrics query "model_shard_warmup_time_ms{region=\"eu-north\"}"
```

scaler-bot: Preflight job scheduled at 01:10 UTC. Job ID: preflight-197654

alert-bot: Calendar event created: "EU-NORTH GPU preempt sim" Wed 07/06 01:30-02:15 UTC. Internal pagers suppressed for 60m. External customer alerts left enabled.

peter: Preflight snapshot uploaded to s3://ops-snapshots/197654-snapshot. Pool health OK.

mina: Injecting simulated preemption now. Command: `redwood-sim preempt --region eu-north --pool gpu-pool --pct 40 --dry-run=false`

scaler-bot: Injection started at 01:32 UTC. Observed node delta: -42 nodes. Autoscaler metrics streaming.

ash: Cold-starts ramping as expected. Current p95 startup = 4200ms (baseline ~800ms). Holding canary. If any node reports startup >10000ms or customer errors >1% we pause.

ops-bot: Canary traffic 3% initiated at 01:35 UTC. Job ID: canary-197654-A

monitor-bot: Canary report: p95 latency +120ms vs baseline, client errors 0.02%, model load time spike noted but within internal leniency. No customer-facing 5xxs detected.

peter: Autoscaler reacted and started scale-up to target capacity. Observed API queue depth spike during scaling; applying temporary token-throttle at edge to smooth client QPS.

mina: Acknowledged. Keep throttling conservative so we don't hide real behaviour. Continue ramp to 30% traffic for stress validation.

ash: During 30% step we saw transient 429s tied to model-shard warmup race on newly provisioned nodes (~90s window). Mitigation: trigger targeted prefetch of hot shards on node-init; applied as hotfix command `redwood-node prefetch --shards hot --region eu-north`

scaler-bot: Hotfix executed, rollout status=SUCCESS. New nodes completed warmup within expected window.

monitor-bot: Post-hotfix: p95 and errors returned to baseline. Resuming ramp to 100% progressive steps.

mina: Scale-up completed to compensate preemption; end-to-end checks green. Leaving internal SLO leniency annotation for 15m cooldown.

peter: Postmortem bullets (initial): root cause = prefetch not invoked fast enough during aggressive autoscale churn. Action items: 1) ensure node-init prefetch (ash), 2) autoscaler cooldown tuning to avoid node churn (peter), 3) add startup-time canary to CI (mina), 4) add synthetic test for model-shard warmup (ops).

oncall: I'm oncall for next 30m. If any customer-impacting error appears (>0.5% errors or >2x p99), we'll rollback by throttling generator and restoring preemption state. Rollback command for sim: `redwood-sim rollback --id preempt-197654 --reason unexpected_client_error`

mina: Thanks team. Please ack attendance and assigned actions here. Quick sync 15m before start in #eng-sre. :eyes:

peter: Ack and taking autoscaler cooldown tuning.

ash: Ack, will add prefetch in node-init and write tests.

oncall: Ack, standing by.
